About this video :-
How Explainer Videos Are Created Using AI | Simple Workflow Explained
Explainer videos are everywhere — on YouTube, social media, websites, and apps. Many creators and businesses use them to explain ideas, products, or concepts clearly in a short amount of time. In this video, I’m breaking down how explainer videos are created using AI tools that can generate content quickly from just a topic or prompt.
These AI tools work by taking a written topic or short description and automatically turning it into a structured explanation using visuals, narration, and scenes. Instead of scripting, recording, and editing everything manually, the AI handles the basic storytelling flow — making explainer-style content easier to understand for beginners.
What this video focuses on 👇
• What explainer videos are and why they’re popular
• How AI tools generate explanations from text topics
• How narration and visuals are combined automatically
• Why explainer videos are widely used for education and information
• How creators use such tools to save time and effort
